# `set_wheel_setting`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Update the filter-wheel slot names and/or per-slot exposure times.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / probable (64-bit and 32-bit builds) |
| Side-effect tier | C |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xd2130 (64-bit build) |

Params are an object (or an array whose first element is an object). Optional names (string array) and exp_sec (number array, integers or reals); absent members leave the corresponding map unchanged, a member of the wrong container type is silently ignored, unknown keys are ignored and an empty object succeeds. A wrong element type fails with 105 (names) or 108 (exp_sec). Each array is applied through a setter that needs an open wheel and exactly as many entries as the current map. Members are applied in wire order and the first failure stops processing; changes already applied stay, with no rollback. Persists via SaveEFWName and SaveEFWExp.

Side effects: Replaces the in-memory name and/or exposure maps and writes them to persistent storage. No rollback, no timeout.

## Request params

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | any | yes | - | Client-chosen request identifier, echoed in the reply as parsed (same JSON type). Required; a request without one is rejected with code 200. The device accepts any JSON value: zero, negative, string, null, boolean and composite ids are all treated as real requests, not notifications. Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |
| `method` | string | yes | - | Fixed value `"set_wheel_setting"`. [READ] |
| `params` | object | yes | - | Object form. The positional form [object] is also accepted. Both members are optional; an empty object succeeds. [READ] |
| `params.names` | array<string> | no | - | New slot names, zero-based slot order. Length must equal the current slot count (209 otherwise). Wrong container type: ignored. Non-string element: 105. [READ] |
| `params.exp_sec` | array<number> | no | - | New per-slot exposure values, zero-based slot order; unit seconds (INFERRED from the member name). Length must equal the current slot count (209 otherwise). Wrong container type: ignored. Non-numeric element: 108. No per-value bounds are imposed. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 107 | Params missing or not an object (after unwrapping an array) | `expected object param` |
| 105 | An element of names is not a string | `expected string param` |
| 108 | An element of exp_sec is not a number | `expected float param` |
| 318 | No wheel is open | `device not connected` |
| 209 | Array length differs from the current slot count | `invalid value` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

## Example

Request, request - Update exposures only (values invented):

```json
{"id":131,"method":"set_wheel_setting","params":{"exp_sec":[10,10,15]}}
```

Request, both:

```json
{"id":132,"method":"set_wheel_setting","params":{"names":["Dark","IR cut","Light pollution"],"exp_sec":[10,10,15]}}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_wheel_setting","result":0,"code":0,"id":131}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"set_wheel_setting","error":"invalid value","code":209,"id":133}
```
